senses.gloss:
ह्नु ह्नु, ii. 2, Ātm.
 1. To take away, Bhaṭṭ. 15, 88.
 2. To conceal one's self, Pāṇ. i. 4, 34.
 --With अप अप,
 1. To conceal, Naiṣ. 1, 49.
 2. To deny, to disclaim, Man. 8, 53. []
 --With नि नि, To deny, Man. 8, 59.
 --With अतिनि अति-नि, To deny strongly, Daśak. in Chr. 193, 9.
 --With अपनि अप-नि, To conceal, Mālat. 16, 14.
 --Cf. Lat. ab-nuere, nutare, gnavus, navare, i-gnavus, se-gnis, niti, nictare, con-nivere; Goth. hneivan, hnaivs; A.S. hnigan; ἀνα-νεύω, νεύω, νυστάζω, νυθός, etc.
